as_told.title: Varginha creature taken to Campinas and then to Area 51

plain: A creature said to have been captured in Brazil in 1996 was first taken to a famous pathologist in the city of Campinas, Badan Palhares, a friend of a doctor named Rodrigues, and then flown to Area 51, the secret US Air Force test site in Nevada. The surgeon Italo Venturelli tells Michels this was "the story" he heard, and he repeats it in a later episode. If true, the US would have taken a creature from Brazil.
